The '''bald raider'''<ref name="audio description">{{FOTV|1|1}} audio description</ref> is a character {{In|FOTV}}.

==Background==
===Post-War===
This bald wastelander with a sweet tooth was one of [[Lee Moldaver|Moldaver]]'s [[Vault 32 raider|raiders]] during their invasion and occupation of [[Vault 32]]. 

==''Fallout'' TV series==
===[[The End (episode)|The End]]===
The bald raider is seen amongst his comrades heading to [[Vault 33]] led by [[Lee Moldaver]] to exchange the new breeder, [[Monty (TV series)|Monty]] to marry, [[Lucy MacLean|Lucy]].

Afterward, he attends the wedding ceremony between Lucy and Monty, sits at a table enjoying the food, and attends the dance after that.

Later, when the [[Vault 32 raider]]s reveal their true motives and start shooting up the place. The bald raider is seen taking a hunk of cake, stuffing his mouth with it, and joining the bloodbath.

He'd soon aim his gun at Lucy with a menacing grin, but a [[Vault 33 dweller]] kicks his gun away and him to the ground. As he got back up, another raider accidentally slices his abdomen with an [[axe (TV series)|axe]] and he shoots dead a fellow raider of his while his gun unintentionally fires at the screen projector, causing it to malfunction.

The bald raider appears only {{in|FOTV}}.
